text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh! That's so… incredibly super frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ughhh! My legs! What's with them? Why don't they burn with fiery rage?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And after I finally had the chance to race you again! If this was Princess Fighter, this is where I'd… I'd go full force…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And magnificently pulverize my rival into bits! Waaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Take a look around, Kawakami…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone's applauding us, and it's because we all ran with everything we had.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Kawakami. It's only because you declared yourself my rival that I came to understand the joy of competing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can't make any promises, but would you race me again, Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Why, of course! I'd give anything for the opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion! Fiiiiinnne!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A and B
text_block_list.text: Fiiiiine Motiooon! Sniffle… Yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Forge ahead, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll be watching you intently all the way!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: You still have time, don't you?
You still have time, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …! You're right.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: As long as I'm with you… I can run to the very ends of the Earth!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's make the best memories we can until the day we have to part!
